HeliBoard nopopup

Personal fork of HeliBoard with the system spell-check suggestions popup stripped to only "Add to dictionary"/"Delete" (the long suggestion list is suppressed). Source: https://github.com/d33mobile/HeliBoard/tree/nopopup

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://d33mobile.github.io/heliboard-nopopup-fdroid/repo
